blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Thyroid ultrasound supports the assessment of nodule malignancy, but classification predictions often lack evidence linked to familiar clinical descriptions. Radiomics provides explicitly defined measurements that can support such explanations through a clinical dictionary. However, using these measurements as interpretable evidence requires reliable estimation from ultrasound images and preservation of measurement fidelity when optimizing classification performance. We propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. Within this model, Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) estimates measurements with balanced supervision across feature families. Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) constructs a fixed bottleneck, followed by joint optimization of measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition then traces feature contributions through a linear classifier and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Experiments on ThyroidXL and TN3K show competitive classification performance, while case studies illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules. These findings indicate interpretable classification with inspectable quantitative evidence informed by clinical knowledge. Code is available online.
blocks.zh: 甲状腺超声波支持结核恶性评估,但分类预测往往缺乏与熟悉的临床描述相联的证据. 放射学提供明确定义的测量,可以通过临床词典支持这种解释. 然而,使用这些测量作为可解释的证据,需要从超声波图像中作出可靠的估计,并在优化分类性能时保持测量忠心。 我们提出甲状腺结核分类的临床-词典放射瓶颈模型。 在这一模式中,家庭-知识放射学习(FARL)在对各特色家庭进行均衡监督的情况下对测量进行估算。 Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling(FGBM)构建了固定的瓶颈,然后在忠诚度指导下共同优化测量估计和分类. 决策证据分解后通过线性分解器来追踪贡献,并按临床词典类别加以组织. 关于甲状腺素XL和TN3K的实验显示有竞争力的分类性能,而案例研究则说明了对良性和恶性结核的贡献。 这些调查结果表明,可解释的分类和可检查的量化证据以临床知识为依据。 代码可在网上查阅。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Clinicians rely on ultrasound findings to determine which thyroid nodules warrant biopsy or follow-up and which require no further evaluation ( Tessler et al., 2017 ) . Classification models can support these decisions, but a predicted label alone does not reveal which findings support the prediction. For these predictions to be clinically interpretable, their underlying evidence should be inspectable and linked to familiar ultrasound descriptions.
blocks.zh: 临床医生依靠超声波检测结果来确定哪些甲状腺结核需要进行活检或后续检查,哪些不需要进一步评价(Tessler等人,2017年)。 分类模型可以支持这些决定,但仅一个预测标签并不能显示哪些结论支持预测. 为了使这些预测在临床上可以解释,其基本证据应当可以检查,并与熟悉的超声波描述联系起来.

blocks.en: Existing studies have explored interpretable concepts and visual prototypes to explain image classification decisions. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) map images to human-interpretable concepts and use the estimated concept values for classification ( Oikarinen et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2023 ; Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) . Prototype-based methods instead relate image regions to learned prototypes or part-based concepts, providing visual evidence for their predictions ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Alehdaghi et al., 2026 ) . However, the resulting explanations do not necessarily align with established ultrasound descriptors, limiting how directly they can be interpreted in clinical assessment.
blocks.zh: 现有的研究探索了可解释的概念和视觉原型,以解释图像分类决定. Bottleneck Models将图像映射到人类可解释的概念,并使用估计的概念值进行分类(Oikarien等,2023;Yukskgonul等,2023;Chowdhury等,2024)。 以原型为基础的方法将图像区域与所学的原型或部分概念联系起来,为其预测提供视觉证据(Wang等,2025;Alehdaghi等,2026)。 然而,由此产生的解释不一定与既定的超声波描述词一致,限制了在临床评估中如何直接解释.

blocks.en: To connect model explanations more closely with clinical assessment, radiomics provides quantitative measurements of lesion geometry, intensity, and texture, computed within segmented regions ( van Griethuysen et al., 2017 ) . Beyond their direct use for classification ( Guerrisi et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025 ) , these measurements can also support clinical interpretation. A clinical dictionary links selected measurements to five familiar ultrasound descriptor categories: composition, echogenicity, shape, margin, and echogenic foci ( Salmanpour et al., 2026 ) . This association provides clinical context, while explicit measurement definitions allow predicted values to be checked against measured references. However, directly using these measurements for classification requires segmentation at inference. Radiomic measurements have also been used as additional supervision during model training ( Salama et al., 2026 ) , but this does not make them the primary basis of model decisions. This motivates predicting clinically associated radiomic measurements from ultrasound images and using these predictions for classification.
blocks.zh: 为了将模型解释与临床评估更紧密地联系起来,放射学提供了分块区域内所计算的损伤几何、强度和纹理的定量测量(van Griethuysen等,2017年)。 除了直接用于分类(Guerrisi等,2024;Fang等,2025)之外,这些测量还可以支持临床解释. 临床词典将选定的测量与5个熟悉的超声波描述类别联系起来:组成、回声成因、形状、边距和回声成因(Salmanpour等,2026年)。 这种关联提供了临床背景,而明确的测量定义则允许对照所测量的参考物来检查预测值. 然而,直接使用这些测量方法进行分类,需要在推断时进行分化. 在模型培训期间,辐射测量也被用作额外的监督(Salama等人,2026年),但这并没有使其成为模型决定的主要依据. 这促使人们从超声波图像中预测临床相关的放射测量,并利用这些预测进行分类.

blocks.en: Using predicted, clinically associated radiomic measurements to perform image-only classification raises two interrelated challenges. First, radiomic measurements span different families that capture complementary aspects of nodule characteristics. These families may differ in learning difficulty, so improved overall estimation accuracy does not guarantee reliable predictions across them. Second, the predicted measurements must support benign–malignant classification while remaining faithful to measured references. Classification performance and measurement fidelity are not necessarily aligned, as errors in individual measurements can affect classification differently. Reducing overall estimation error may not improve diagnostic discrimination, whereas optimizing classification alone may compromise measurement fidelity.
blocks.zh: 利用预测,临床上相联的放射测量来进行只用图像的分类,提出了两个相互关联的挑战. 第一,辐射测量跨越不同家族,捕捉结核特性的互补方面。 这些家庭在学习难度上可能有所不同,因此总体估计准确度的提高不能保证它们之间的可靠预测. 第二,预测的测量必须支持良性-恶性分类,同时忠于衡量参考。 分类性能和度量忠诚度不一定一致,因为个别度量中的错误可能对分类产生不同的影响. 减少总体估计误差可能无法改善诊断性歧视,而优化分类本身可能损害衡量忠诚度。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for thyroid nodule classification. The model estimates quantitative measurements directly from ultrasound images and performs classification without requiring segmentation at inference. Our main contributions are threefold: (1) Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL) balances supervision across radiomic measurement families to learn complementary quantitative information. (2) Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM) builds on these estimates, using measurement fidelity to guide bottleneck construction, after which it jointly optimizes estimation and classification to limit measurement drift. (3) Decision evidence decomposition enables feature contributions to be traced and organized by clinical dictionary categories, with a linear classifier making decisions solely from selected measurements. Experiments on two thyroid ultrasound datasets, ThyroidXL and TN3K, demonstrate competitive classification performance, while case-level analyses illustrate feature contributions for benign and malignant nodules.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提出甲状腺结核分类临床-词典放射瓶颈模型。 该模型直接从超声波图像中估算定量测量,并进行分类,无需在推断时进行分解. 我们的主要贡献有三: (1) 家庭-知识型放射学(FARL)平衡对放射测量家庭的监督,以学习补充性定量信息。 (2)Fidelity-Guided Botleneck Modeling(FGBM)以这些估计为基础,利用测量忠心来指导瓶颈构造,之后它联合优化估计和分类,以限制测量漂移. (3)决定证据分解使特征贡献能够被跟踪和按临床词典分类组织,线性分解器完全通过所选的测量来决策. 在两个甲状腺超声波数据集 -- -- 甲状腺XL和TN3K -- -- 上的实验表明,它们具有竞争性的分类性能,而案例分析则说明对良性结核和恶性结核的贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The proposed model is trained in two stages: Family-Aware Radiomic Learning (FARL, Stage 1) and Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling (FGBM, Stage 2). FARL learns per-image radiomic features with equally weighted family losses using offline targets from image–mask pairs, as shown in (a). Predictions are averaged per case and passed through a fixed dictionary bottleneck constructed through the reliability- and redundancy-based selection shown in (b). FGBM jointly optimizes the encoder and linear classifier with a fidelity loss anchored to frozen FARL predictions. Classification uses only bottleneck features, and inference requires ultrasound images alone.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 拟议模式分两个阶段培训: 家庭知识放射学习(FARL,第1阶段)和Fidelity-Guided Bottleneck Modeling(FGBM,第2阶段). FARL使用图像-掩码对的离线目标来学习每个图像的放射特征,这些特征具有同等加权的家庭损失,如(a)所示。 预测是每个案例的平均数,并通过一个固定的字典瓶颈,通过(b)中以可靠性和冗余为基础的选择来构建。 FGBM联合优化了编码器和线性分解器,并锁定了被冻结的FARL预测的忠诚度损失. 分类只使用瓶颈特征,推论仅需要超声波图像.

blocks.en: 2  Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1  Model Overview
blocks.zh: 2.1 模式概览

blocks.en: Figure 1 illustrates our model, which predicts radiomic measurements from ultrasound images and uses selected estimates as a diagnostic bottleneck. For each case, let X = { x 1 , … , x n } X=\{x_{1},\ldots,x_{n}\} denote its n n ultrasound images and y y denote its label. Using the corresponding lesion masks, a reference vector 𝐫 t ∈ ℝ p \mathbf{r}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{p} comprising p p radiomic features with explicit measurement definitions is extracted offline from each image x t x_{t} . The clinical dictionary associates selected features with clinical description categories, where D k D_{k} denotes the features associated with category k k . FARL learns to estimate the full radiomic feature vector from images, while FGBM constructs a fixed bottleneck M ⊆ ⋃ k D k M\subseteq\bigcup_{k}D_{k} and jointly optimizes feature estimation and classification. Feature contributions from a linear classifier using only the selected predictions are traced and organized by clinical dictionary categories.

blocks.en: 3  Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1  Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Dataset. We evaluate our method on two public thyroid ultrasound datasets, ThyroidXL ( Duong et al., 2025 ) and TN3K ( Gong et al., 2023 ) , containing 11,554 and 3,493 image–mask pairs, respectively. Benign–malignant labels are obtained from cytology or histopathology for ThyroidXL and from TNCD ( Gong et al., 2022 ) for TN3K. We use fixed training, validation, and test splits comprising 2,678/670/736 patients for ThyroidXL and 2,303/576/614 images for TN3K. Evaluation is patient-level for ThyroidXL and image-level for TN3K, per the dataset protocols.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们用两个公开的甲状腺超声波数据集,即ThyroidXL(Duong等人,2025年)和TN3K(Gong等人,2023年)来评价我们的方法,它们分别包含11,554和3,493个图像-面具对. Benign-malignant标签来自甲状腺XL的细胞学或组织病理学以及TN3K的NCD(Gong等,2022年)。 我们使用固定的训练、鉴定和测试分解,包括2 678/670/736名ThyroidXL病人和2 303/576/614名TN3K病人的图像。 根据数据集协议,评价为甲状腺XL的患者级别和TN3K的图像级别。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We use PyRadiomics to extract 102 radiomic features from native-resolution images using lesion masks, covering geometry (9), intensity (18), and texture (75). We adopt ImageNet-pretrained ConvNeXt-Tiny with 384 × 384 384\times 384 inputs and AdamW (learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , batch size 8). Training consists of 80 FARL epochs followed by 20 FGBM epochs, with λ cls = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{cls}}=0.5 and λ fid = 3 \lambda_{\mathrm{fid}}=3 . Bottleneck selection uses τ rel = 0.3 \tau_{\mathrm{rel}}=0.3 and τ red = 0.9 \tau_{\mathrm{red}}=0.9 . Checkpoints in both stages are selected by the highest mean validation R 2 R^{2} across 102 transformed radiomic targets. Experiments are conducted in PyTorch on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU and repeated with three random seeds. We report mean ± \pm standard deviation (SD) for AUC, balanced accuracy (BACC), and the feature-averaged Spearman correlation ρ ¯ \bar{\rho} between predicted and reference values across the 102 features.

blocks.en: 3.2  Comparison Experiment
blocks.zh: 3.2 比较实验

blocks.en: Table 1 compares our method with radiomics-based, black-box, and interpretable classification approaches. Our method achieves mean AUC and BACC of 94.77 % 94.77\% and 86.73 % 86.73\% on ThyroidXL, with 79.49 % 79.49\% and 72.23 % 72.23\% on TN3K. Among radiomics references, TU1.0 and Oracle radiomics achieve higher performance on ThyroidXL but require ground-truth masks at inference. In contrast, Seg-first radiomics uses predicted masks but performs worse than our method on both datasets, while our approach outperforms all three radiomics references on TN3K. Compared with black-box methods, our method outperforms RCAF ( Sherif et al., 2026 ) and RLAR on both datasets, with AUC only 0.21 and 1.83 percentage points below direct image classification. Within interpretable methods, our approach achieves the highest mean AUC and BACC on both datasets. These results demonstrate competitive classification performance while relying solely on predicted radiomic features and providing traceable quantitative evidence.
blocks.zh: 表1将我们的方法与基于放射、黑盒和可解释的分类方法进行比较。 我们的方法意味着甲型六氯环己烷和乙型六氯环己烷在甲型六氯环己烷中的比例为94.77%、86.73%、86.73%、79.49%、72.23%。 在放射学参考文献中,TU1.0和甲骨文放射学在甲状腺XL上取得了更高的性能,但在推论中需要地面真实口罩. 相比之下,Seg-First放射线使用预测的口罩,但在两个数据集上的性能都比我们的方法差,而我们的方法则比TN3K上所有三个放射线参考都好. 与黑盒方法相比,我们的方法在两个数据集上都超过了RCAF(Sherif等人,2026年)和RLAR,AUC仅低于直接图像分类0.21和1.83个百分点. 在可解释的方法中,我们的方法在两个数据集上都达到了最高的平均值AUC和BACC. 这些结果显示了竞争性分类业绩,同时完全依靠预测的放射特征并提供可追踪的定量证据。

blocks.en: 3.3  Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: Table 2 evaluates the key designs of FARL and FGBM. As shown, omitting family balancing slightly reduces mean AUC on both datasets, whereas removing joint optimization causes larger declines of 2.57 and 6.25 percentage points on ThyroidXL and TN3K, respectively. In contrast to the consistent AUC reductions, measurement fidelity exhibits different trends across datasets. With separate training, ρ ¯ \bar{\rho} decreases slightly from 91.34 to 91.22 on ThyroidXL but increases from 84.19 to 84.90 on TN3K. This difference underscores the importance of considering measurement fidelity alongside classification performance. Moreover, without the fidelity loss, ρ ¯ \bar{\rho} decreases on both datasets, accompanied by lower AUC. These results show that fidelity guidance helps preserve the correspondence between predicted and measured radiomic features, supporting the interpretation of feature contributions.
blocks.zh: 表2评价了FARL和FGBM的关键设计. 如上所示,略去家庭平衡意味着两个数据集的AUC减少,而取消联合优化则导致甲状腺XL和TN3K分别下降2.57和6.25个百分点。 与连续不断的AUC减少形成对照的是,衡量忠诚度显示出不同数据集的不同趋势。 在经过单独训练后,甲状腺XL试验从91.34降至91.22,但TN3K试验从84.19增至84.90。 这一差别突出了在考虑分类业绩的同时考虑衡量忠诚的重要性。 此外,如果没有忠诚的丧失,两个数据集都减少了,同时还有较低的AUC。 这些结果表明,忠诚指导有助于保持预测和测量的放射特征之间的对应性,支持对特征贡献的解释。

blocks.en: 3.4  Case Study
blocks.zh: 3.4 个案研究

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates how the clinical dictionary organizes quantitative evidence from contrasting nodule appearances. Net category contributions are dominated by echogenicity and margin in the benign case, but by shape and composition in the malignant case. Within these categories, GLCM Id reflects the benign nodule’s relatively uniform texture, whereas shape2D Elongation and GLSZM SmallAreaEmphasis reflect the malignant nodule’s elongation and prevalence of small homogeneous zones. Taken together, these findings show how the model combines quantitative evidence and clinical context to explain individual predictions.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了临床词典如何通过对比结核外观来组织定量证据。 在良性情况下,净类别贡献主要为回声率和比值,而恶性情况下则以形状和组成为主。 在这些类别中,GLCM Id反映了良性结核的纹理相对一致,而形状2D延展和GLSZM SmallAreEphasis则反映了恶性结核的延展和小同质区的流行。 综合起来,这些发现表明模型如何将定量证据和临床背景结合起来,以解释个人的预测.

blocks.en: 4  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents a clinical-dictionary radiomic bottleneck model for interpretable thyroid nodule classification from ultrasound images. Specifically, FARL balances supervision across feature families, while FGBM jointly optimizes measurement estimation and classification under fidelity guidance. Decision evidence decomposition traces feature contributions and organizes them by clinical dictionary categories. Results on ThyroidXL and TN3K demonstrate a balance between classification performance and measurement fidelity. In addition, the model makes the quantitative basis of individual predictions inspectable through traceable feature contributions associated with ultrasound descriptions. Future work will extend this model to more medical scenarios by incorporating task-specific quantitative measurements and clinical knowledge.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了从超声波图像解释性甲状腺结核分类的临床-词典放射瓶颈模型. 具体地说,FARL平衡了各特色家庭的监督,而FGBM在忠诚度指导下共同优化了测量估计和分类. 决策证据分解跟踪特征贡献,并按临床字典类别组织. 关于甲状腺素XL和TN3K的结果表明,分类性能与测量忠诚度之间保持了平衡。 此外,该模型通过与超声波描述相关的可追踪特征贡献,使个人预测的定量基础可以检查. 今后的工作将通过纳入针对具体任务的定量测量和临床知识,将这一模型扩大到更多的医疗情况。

blocks.en: Compliance with Ethical Standards. This retrospective study used the publicly available ThyroidXL ( Duong et al., 2025 ) and TN3K ( Gong et al., 2023 ) datasets, with no additional participant recruitment or data collection.
